title: Job Openings at Kilimanjaro Restaurant
content:
Kilimanjaro Restaurant, a Subsidiary of Sundry  Food, is a  food services company in Nigeria and has been in business since 2004. What started as a simple need to make great-tasting, healthy food accessible to all who want it at a price they can afford has today grown to close to a 100 branches of foodservice brands across the country and still growing. When we started Sundry Foods, we wanted to create a solution to a problem - a gap in the market for quality Nigerian meals prepared and served to international standards. We are Sundry Foods, we prepare familiar meals for your comfort and enjoyment Our mantra: BetterFood, Better Service, Better People”. 

We are recruiting to fill the position below:
     

            
    



Job Position: Front of House Staff

Job Location: Omole Phase 1, Berger - Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

General Requirements
Interested Candidates:


	Must have SSCE or ND as the maximum educational qualifications.
	Must have a NIN Slip.
	Be a resident of Ogudu, Ogba, Omole Berger,and its environs.


Salary
N75,000 - N80,000 / month.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CVs to: [email protected] using the Job Position and Location as the subject of the mail (E.g. Front of House Staff -  Omole Phase 1).

Note


	For more enquires, contact: 08156990379 (WhatsApp Only).
	Only eligible candidates seeking to build a career in the hospitality and food service industry are encouraged to apply.

&nbsp;Job&nbsp;Position: Administrative&nbsp;Manager

Job Location: Ibese, Ogun

Description


	The Administrative Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and supervising all administrative and general service functions within Dangote Cement Transport Ibese.
	The role ensures efficient support to transport operations by managing facilities, office administration, staff logistics, fleet support, documentation, vendor management, and cost optimization in line with DCT operational standards and Dangote Group policies.


Key Responsibilities


	&nbsp;Oversee the day-to-day administrative functions across the DCT Ibese base and other operational sites.
	Develop, implement, and enforce administrative policies, procedures, and service standards.
	Coordinate administrative staff activities, including clerical, security, cleaning, and facility support teams.
	Ensure prompt provision of administrative support to the whole departments and units in the plant
	Supervise the maintenance, repair, and utilization of company facilities, offices, and staff accommodations.
	Ensure the availability of utilities (power, water, internet, etc.) and monitor service performance.
	Coordinate staff movement logistics, including vehicles for official assignments, transport of tyres, and materials to DCT locations.
	Oversee drivers assigned to administrative duties and ensure compliance with company driving standards.
	Manage procurement of administrative items and consumables in collaboration with the Procurement Unit and within approved budgets.
	Maintain accurate records of office inventory, materials issuance, and usage.
	Ensure proper documentation and accountability for company assets and consumables.
	Supervise and evaluate external service providers, contractors, and facility maintenance vendors.
	Negotiate and review service contracts to ensure cost-effectiveness and service quality.
	Ensure compliance with company standards and statutory requirements for all third-party engagements.
	Manage employee welfare programs and ensure proper coordination of wellness initiatives across the organization.
	Oversee the provision and timely distribution of staff uniforms in collaboration with HR and Procurement.
	Coordinate long service awards, end-of-year parties, and other staff recognition or engagement programs.
	Manage employee health and insurance programs, including Health Maintenance Organization (HMO) enrollment, updates, and complaint resolution.
	Ensure proper administration of Group Life Insurance, National Social Insurance Trust Fund (NSITF), and other statutory welfare schemes.
	Support HR in addressing welfare-related issues and ensuring staff satisfaction and well-being.
	Prepare and manage the administrative department&rsquo;s annual budget.
	Monitor expenditures and enforce cost control measures to achieve operational efficiency.
	Generate and present periodic administrative reports and expenditure summaries to management.


Qualifications and Experience


	Bachelor&rsquo;s Degree in business administration, Management, or related field.
	Minimum of 8 years of relevant experience, including at least 3 years in a managerial role within manufacturing, logistics, or transport operations.
	Professional qualification in HR Management e.g. professional in CIPM, SPHR will be added advantage
	Proven experience in facility management, office administration, and vendor coordination.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and ERP tools.


Skills and Competencies:


	Strong leadership and team management skills.
	Excellent organizational, planning, and time management abilities.
	Sound communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
	High attention to detail, integrity, and confidentiality.
	Strong problem-solving and cost management acumen.
	Ability to work under pressure and handle multiple priorities.


Benefits


	Training and Development
	Private Health Insurance
	Pension Plan
	Paid Time Off.

Administrative Manager Job at Dangote Group




        
    

        
        Dangote Group is one of Nigeria’s most diversified business conglomerates with a hard – earned reputation for excellent business practices and products’ quality with its operational headquarters in the bustling metropolis of Lagos, Nigeria in West Africa.

We are recruiting to fill the position below: 

 Job Position: Administrative Manager

Job Location: Ibese, Ogun

Description
     

            
    




	The Administrative Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and supervising all administrative and general service functions within Dangote Cement Transport Ibese.
	The role ensures efficient support to transport operations by managing facilities, office administration, staff logistics, fleet support, documentation, vendor management, and cost optimization in line with DCT operational standards and Dangote Group policies.


Key Responsibilities


	 Oversee the day-to-day administrative functions across the DCT Ibese base and other operational sites.
	Develop, implement, and enforce administrative policies, procedures, and service standards.
	Coordinate administrative staff activities, including clerical, security, cleaning, and facility support teams.
	Ensure prompt provision of administrative support to the whole departments and units in the plant
	Supervise the maintenance, repair, and utilization of company facilities, offices, and staff accommodations.
	Ensure the availability of utilities (power, water, internet, etc.) and monitor service performance.
	Coordinate staff movement logistics, including vehicles for official assignments, transport of tyres, and materials to DCT locations.
	Oversee drivers assigned to administrative duties and ensure compliance with company driving standards.
	Manage procurement of administrative items and consumables in collaboration with the Procurement Unit and within approved budgets.
	Maintain accurate records of office inventory, materials issuance, and usage.
	Ensure proper documentation and accountability for company assets and consumables.
	Supervise and evaluate external service providers, contractors, and facility maintenance vendors.
	Negotiate and review service contracts to ensure cost-effectiveness and service quality.
	Ensure compliance with company standards and statutory requirements for all third-party engagements.
	Manage employee welfare programs and ensure proper coordination of wellness initiatives across the organization.
	Oversee the provision and timely distribution of staff uniforms in collaboration with HR and Procurement.
	Coordinate long service awards, end-of-year parties, and other staff recognition or engagement programs.
	Manage employee health and insurance programs, including Health Maintenance Organization (HMO) enrollment, updates, and complaint resolution.
	Ensure proper administration of Group Life Insurance, National Social Insurance Trust Fund (NSITF), and other statutory welfare schemes.
	Support HR in addressing welfare-related issues and ensuring staff satisfaction and well-being.
	Prepare and manage the administrative department’s annual budget.
	Monitor expenditures and enforce cost control measures to achieve operational efficiency.
	Generate and present periodic administrative reports and expenditure summaries to management.


Qualifications and Experience


	Bachelor’s Degree in business administration, Management, or related field.
	Minimum of 8 years of relevant experience, including at least 3 years in a managerial role within manufacturing, logistics, or transport operations.
	Professional qualification in HR Management e.g. professional in CIPM, SPHR will be added advantage
	Proven experience in facility management, office administration, and vendor coordination.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and ERP tools.


Skills and Competencies:


	Strong leadership and team management skills.
	Excellent organizational, planning, and time management abilities.
	Sound communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
	High attention to detail, integrity, and confidentiality.
	Strong problem-solving and cost management acumen.
	Ability to work under pressure and handle multiple priorities.


Benefits


	Training and Development
	Private Health Insurance
	Pension Plan
	Paid Time Off.

Sales and Marketing Executive (Aluminium PU/PIR Panels) Job at Tower Alloys Industries Limited




        
    

        
        Tower Alloys Industries Limited - We are the pioneer manufacturer in the Aluminium sector in Nigeria.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position : Sales and Marketing Executive (Aluminium PU/PIR Panels)

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Industry: Manufacturing – Building Materials

Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking experienced and results-oriented Sales Executives to drive business development and sales for our newly established Aluminium PU/PIR Sandwich Panel Plant.
	The ideal candidates will possess strong industry knowledge, an established customer network, and a proven ability to generate sales within the building materials and construction sector.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve revenue and market share targets.
	Identify and acquire new customers within the construction, industrial, cold room, roofing, and building materials sectors.
	Build and maintain strong relationships with contractors, developers, consultants, distributors, and key decision-makers.
	Promote and sell Aluminium PU/PIR Sandwich Panels and related products.
	Conduct market research and monitor competitor activities to identify new business opportunities.
	Prepare quotations, negotiate contracts, and close sales.
	Coordinate with production and logistics teams to ensure timely order fulfillment.
	Prepare weekly and monthly sales reports and forecasts.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree or HND in Marketing, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
	Minimum of 5 years of sales experience within the building materials or construction products industry.
	Proven experience selling Aluminium Composite Panels (ACP), Sandwich Panels, Roofing Products, Insulation Materials, Steel Products, or related construction materials.
	Strong network within the construction and industrial sectors.
	Excellent negotiation, communication, and relationship management skills.
	Self-driven with the ability to meet and exceed sales targets.


What We Offer


	Competitive remuneration package.
	Performance-based incentives.
	Opportunity to be part of a growing manufacturing business.
	Career growth and professional development opportunities.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send a copy of their updated resume to: [email protected] using "Sales Executive – Aluminium PU/PIR Panels" as the subject of the mail.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
